**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** — no redline, no comment, document unchanged.

There was no substantive defect to repair on this pass. The verifier's narrative confirmed every element of the finding (status, anchor paragraph, absence of a redline, and the treatment of the inapplicable checks), so the only change made was to sharpen the rationale:

- Enumerated the full set of neutral personnel provisions confirming absence: § 5, §§ 13.1–13.3, § 13.5, § 14.5 and Exhibit D § 5.
- Stated explicitly why the "general-solicitation carve-out" and "12-month duration" checks cannot be cleared: there is no covenant to narrow, and clearing them would require **inserting** a restriction on Corio — contrary to the preferred position and to our client's interest. I will not fabricate a non-solicit to satisfy a heuristic.
- Retained § 14.10 purely as the scope anchor, with the residual-risk note that the incorporated NDA and Statement of Work are where a non-solicit could reside, and the fallback terms we would apply if so.

Recommended next step outside this rule: obtain the concurrently executed Non-Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work and run the same check against them, since those documents are incorporated by reference and are not in scope of this review.
